type_definitions.name: MathformerLibUpdate

workflows.description: controlled accumulation into the parallel MathformerLib library.

epistemic_contract.assurance_justification: Each occurrence preserves its own generated or computed provenance; the final wrapper follows the final occurrence.
epistemic_contract.defeater_rationale: Evidence labels remain capped until native adapters and independent behavioral oracles execute.
defeaters: A structural or fake-handler run does not establish native execution, mathematical correctness, or semantic equivalence.
observations: The canonical hook registry fixes hook order, owner skills, declared outputs, and gate text.
epistemic_contract.output_meaning: The final domain-specific artifact produced by the layered mathformerlib_accumulation_loop shell.
epistemic_contract.question: What typed artifacts and dispositions result from the declared mathformerlib_accumulation_loop contract?
epistemic_contract.subject: The exact source artifacts and gates traversed by mathformerlib_accumulation_loop.

reasoning_projection.description: Assess candidates, apply promotion, place accepted modules, refresh the registry, and publish MathformerLib documentation.
reasoning_projection.name: UpdateMathformerLib

occurrences.rationale: Classify candidates and run realness, compilation, import, and provenance checks.
Apply the MathformerLib promotion policy to every candidate.
Place accepted modules under domain paths and retain blocked drafts.
Rebuild the authoritative MathformerLib registry after placement.
Generate Markdown library pages and indexes from the refreshed registry.
Publish aligned HTML and return the complete MathformerLib update.

reasoning_projection.projection_scope: complete controlled MathformerLib promotion, placement, registry, and documentation update
